items.title: Hidden Amplifiers: Cross-Level Risk in Software Supply Chains
items.summary: Modern software supply chains comprise hundreds of transitive dependencies, yet existing analysis tools operate at either the ecosystem level (dependency graphs) or the code level (static analysis within packages). This separation creates two failure modes. First, false-positive CVE alerts for unreachable code. Second, blind spots for structurally critical micro-dependencies. We introduce cross-level risk propagation, a framework that bridges code-level risk metrics with ecosystem-level dependency exposure through a unified risk formula. Preliminary evaluation on 50 packages across npm and PyPI reveals a class of hidden amplifiers -- micro-dependencies with fewer than 50 methods but over 50,000 dependents -- that carry outsized supply-chain risk invisible to all current Software Composition Analysis (SCA) tools. Without cross-level analysis, such packages can harbor exploitable code for years because no current tool considers both internal code structure and ecosystem position simultaneously. These results suggest that cross-level analysis opens a new design space for supply-chain security.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 现代软件供应链由数百个传递性依赖组成，但现有分析工具要么在生态系统层面（依赖图）操作，要么在代码层面（包内静态分析）操作。这种分离导致两种失败模式：一是对不可达代码产生误报的CVE警报，二是对结构关键的微依赖存在盲点。本文提出了一种跨层级风险传播框架，通过统一的风险公式将代码级风险指标与生态系统级依赖暴露度联系起来。在npm和PyPI上的50个包上的初步评估揭示了一类“隐藏放大器”——那些方法数少于50但依赖于超过5万个的微依赖——它们承担着超出所有现有SCA工具可见范围的巨大供应链风险。没有跨层级分析，此类包可能多年隐藏可利用代码，因为当前没有工具同时考虑内部代码结构和生态系统位置。这些结果表明，跨层级分析为供应链安全开辟了新的设计空间。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭示了现有SCA工具无法检测的隐蔽风险类别，即结构关键但代码量小的微依赖可能成为供应链攻击放大器，值得安全团队重新评估依赖优先级策略。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可能影响依赖管理工具的设计方向，推动融合代码级与生态级分析的下一代SCA产品。

items.title: Simulating the Resident: Generating Executable Smart Home Schedules via LLM Personas
items.summary: Smart homes have emerged as an important domain for HCI research, including work on usable security and privacy. Ideally, studies in these areas draw on datasets collected in real homes with real residents, capturing authentic device interactions, network traffic, and daily routines. However, creating such datasets is slow, expensive, and raises significant privacy concerns, as it requires long-term observation of people in their most private spaces. We propose using LLMs to generate diverse resident personas that interact with a simulated smart home, producing behaviorally grounded interaction schedules that can be executed on physical testbeds. We present (1) a design framework configuring simulated households across five socio-technical dimensions, (2) a multi-stage LLM pipeline that produces structured, executable device interaction schedules, and (3) a proof of concept demonstrating feasibility. As a work in progress, we aim to support scalable, privacy-conscious smart-home experimentation without relying on intrusive real-world data collection.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对智能家居安全与隐私研究中真实数据集难以获取的问题，提出利用大型语言模型（LLM）生成多样化的居民角色（persona），进而在模拟智能家居环境中生成可执行的设备交互时间表。作者设计了一个包含五个社会技术维度（如家庭成员构成、日常习惯、安全偏好等）的模拟家庭配置框架，并开发了一个多阶段LLM流水线：首先基于框架生成居民角色描述，然后通过对话推理生成符合角色行为的设备操作序列，最后将序列转化为可在物理测试台上执行的调度指令。通过概念验证实验，展示了生成的调度在逻辑合理性和行为多样性上接近真实居民。该工作旨在为智能家居可用安全与隐私研究提供可扩展、隐私友好的数据生成方案，避免侵入式真实数据采集的伦理和成本问题。目前为进行中研究，但已初步验证可行性。读者群体包括智能家居安全研究人员、隐私保护技术开发者以及人机交互（HCI）领域学者。

items.title: ProvICS: A Provenance-based Intrusion Detection for Industrial Control Systems
items.summary: The convergence of Information Technology and Operational Technology has exposed Industrial Control Systems (ICS) to multi-stage cyberattacks that traverse software, network, and physical process layers simultaneously. Although Provenance-based Intrusion Detection Systems (PIDS) are effective in Information Technology (IT) environments, their applicability to Industrial Cyber-Physical Systems (CPS) remains largely unexplored because of the absence of datasets that jointly capture host-level causal behavior, industrial network semantics, and physical process state. To address this gap, we design an open-source, Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) CPS testbed that replicates an industrial chemical reactor control architecture across the Purdue model layers. Using this testbed, we propose ProvICS, a multimodal provenance dataset purpose-built for CPS intrusion detection, which synchronously captures four streams: whole-system provenance graphs from the supervisory host and the resource-constrained PLC, decoded Modbus deep-packet inspection records, and physical process telemetry. The collection comprises a 48-hour benign phase and a 22-hour attack phase across four campaigns covering 20 ICS ATT&CK techniques over 32 attack events, ranging from reconnaissance to physical process manipulation. Comparative analysis shows that ProvICS is among the few existing ICS/CPS benchmarks with multi-host kernel-level provenance, real PLC hardware-in-the-loop execution, decoded Modbus traffic, physical process-state measurements, and auxiliary raw PCAP traces in a time-synchronized collection. Baseline detection further confirms that cross-modal fusion can detect all 32 labeled attack events (F1 = 0.913, false-positive rate (FPR) = 1.40%), demonstrating the dataset's ability to expose complementary attack signals across modalities and addressing a gap not covered by prior benchmarks.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对工业控制系统（ICS）面临的多阶段网络攻击威胁，提出了一种基于溯源的多模态入侵检测数据集 ProvICS。研究背景是信息技术（IT）与操作技术（OT）的融合使ICS暴露于跨软件、网络和物理过程层的攻击，而现有的基于溯源的入侵检测系统（PIDS）在IT环境中有效，但在工业网络物理系统（CPS）中应用不足，主要原因是缺乏同时捕获主机级因果行为、工业网络语义和物理过程状态的数据集。为解决这一问题，作者设计了一个开源、硬件在环（HIL）的CPS测试平台，模拟工业化学反应器控制架构，覆盖Purdue模型各层。基于该平台，提出了ProvICS数据集，同步采集四个数据流：来自监控主机和资源受限PLC的完整系统溯源图、解码的Modbus深度包检测记录以及物理过程遥测。数据集包含48小时的正常阶段和22小时的攻击阶段，涵盖4个攻击战役、20种ICS ATT&CK技术和32个攻击事件，范围从侦察到物理过程操纵。对比分析表明，ProvICS是少数同时具备多主机内核级溯源、真实PLC硬件在环执行、解码Modbus流量、物理过程状态测量以及辅助原始PCAP轨迹的ICS/CPS基准数据集。基于该数据集的基线检测实验表明，跨模态融合能够检测所有32个标注的攻击事件（F1=0.913，假阳性率1.40%），证明数据集能够暴露不同模态间的互补攻击信号，弥补了现有基准的不足。该研究为ICS环境下的入侵检测研究提供了重要的数据资源和评估平台。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 填补了ICS/CPS领域缺乏多模态溯源数据的空白，为开发跨层攻击检测方法提供了高质量基准数据集，有助于提升工业控制系统的安全防护能力。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于工业网络安全研究人员、SOC分析师以及ICS安全产品开发者，可用于评估和训练多模态入侵检测模型，推动溯源分析在ICS领域的实际应用。

items.title: Mini-Programs, Mega-Problems: Unveiling OAuth-based Authentication Misuses in Mini-Programs via Dynamic Analysis
items.summary: Mini-programs have become a dominant paradigm for lightweight application deployment within super apps such as WeChat. To support seamless integration, super apps provide OAuth mechanisms for user login. However, improper integration of OAuth-based Authentication (OBA) flows by third-party developers can lead to critical security flaws. In this paper, we discover three new types of runtime OBA misuses that differ from prior static-code-based studies, enabling attackers to impersonate victims. To assess their real-world impact, we design and implement MINIAUTH, the first analysis framework for systematically analyzing OBA misuse at scale. MINIAUTH automatically pinpoints the OBA login page of a mini-program, executes the workflow dynamically, and analyzes its runtime behaviors. This enables it to handle obfuscated mini-programs and uncover vulnerabilities that existing approaches cannot detect. Applying MINIAUTH to 44,273 WeChat and 2,721 Baidu mini-programs, we uncover 1,834 misuse cases, including critical logic flaws that enable client-side identity forgery via exposed credentials and authentication bypass through static or plaintext identifiers. Our cross-platform evaluation further shows that such misuses are not confined to a single ecosystem but consistently appear across different mini-program platforms. We also identify a cryptographic design flaw in Baidu's OBA APIs that allows brute-forcing of session keys. We responsibly disclosed our findings to the developers and platforms, receiving acknowledgments and assigned CNVD/CNNVD IDs. These results underscore the need for more robust developer guidance and enhanced platform-level safeguards.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本论文针对小程序（Mini-Program）中基于OAuth的认证流程（OBA）存在的安全误用问题进行了深入研究。小程序作为超级应用（如微信）内的轻量级应用部署模式，广泛采用OAuth机制实现用户登录。然而，第三方开发者在集成OBA流程时的不当操作可能导致严重的安全漏洞。作者发现了三种与以往静态代码分析不同的运行时OBA误用类型，攻击者可利用这些漏洞冒充受害者。为评估实际影响，他们设计并实现了MINIAUTH，这是首个系统化大规模分析OBA误用的框架。MINIAUTH能够自动定位小程序的OBA登录页面，动态执行工作流并分析运行时行为，从而处理混淆的小程序并发现现有方法无法检测的漏洞。应用MINIAUTH对44,273个微信小程序和2,721个百度小程序进行检测后，发现了1,834个误用案例，包括通过暴露凭据导致的客户端身份伪造、以及通过静态或明文标识符实现的认证绕过等关键逻辑缺陷。跨平台评估表明，此类误用不限于单一生态系统，而是在不同小程序平台上一致出现。此外，他们还发现了百度OBA API中的一个密码学设计缺陷，该缺陷允许对会话密钥进行暴力破解。作者已将发现负责任地披露给开发者和平台，并获得确认以及分配的CNVD/CNNVD编号。这些结果凸显了加强开发者指导和完善平台级安全防护的必要性。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 小程序普及率极高，OAuth认证误用可直接导致用户身份被冒用，造成账户劫持、数据泄露等严重安全事件，亟需平台和开发者重视。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响微信和百度两大小程序生态，数万小程序中发现的千余个漏洞可被攻击者利用进行身份伪造和认证绕过，波及数亿用户。

items.title: The Masks We (Think We) Wear: Privacy Threats of Browser-Extension Wallets in the Web3 Ecosystem
items.summary: Cryptocurrency wallets are the primary interface for managing pseudonymous blockchain addresses, viewing balances, and interacting with Web3 applications. Although users typically assume that their addresses remain independent of each other unless intentionally revealed, modern wallets routinely communicate with both blockchain infrastructure and decentralized applications (dApps), generating network-side and web-side signals that may undermine this assumption. In this paper, we identify and formalize five privacy threats that arise directly from wallets interacting with the network and the web browser. Using large-scale dynamic measurements of 85 of the most popular Chrome Web Store browser-extension wallets (representing 35.16 million users), we observe that routine remote procedure call (RPC) operations leak structural links between a user's addresses; that the majority of Ethereum wallets implement permission revocation inconsistently and continue to expose previously revoked addresses across sessions; and that many wallets inject their provider interfaces into cross-origin iframes, enabling passive cross-site tracking beyond dApps and potentially real-world identity deanonymization without user interaction. Taken together, our results show that these wallet behaviors leak sensitive information that can be used to link multiple addresses to the same user, track wallet users across sessions and sites, and connect their browsing activity to their on-chain wealth. We discuss practical mitigations and show that many of these threats can be substantially reduced through improved wallet implementation, stronger privacy considerations in ecosystem standards, and stricter controls over provider exposure. Our results highlight the need for standardized, privacy-preserving wallet architectures.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究了Web3生态系统中浏览器扩展加密货币钱包的隐私威胁。用户通常认为其区块链地址是独立的，但钱包在与区块链基础设施和去中心化应用（dApp）交互时会产生网络侧和网页侧信号，可能泄露地址间的关联。作者识别并形式化了五种隐私威胁：1）常规远程过程调用（RPC）操作泄露用户地址间的结构链接；2）大多数以太坊钱包权限撤销不一致，跨会话仍暴露已撤销的地址；3）许多钱包将提供者接口注入跨域iframe，使得被动跨站点跟踪成为可能；4）钱包行为可链接同一用户的多个地址；5）跟踪跨会话和站点的钱包用户，并将浏览活动与链上财富关联。通过大规模动态测量85个最流行的Chrome扩展钱包（覆盖3516万用户），作者验证了这些威胁的存在。实验表明，钱包的RPC行为、权限管理和提供者暴露均存在隐私漏洞。最后，作者提出了缓解措施，包括改进钱包实现、加强生态标准中的隐私考量以及严格控制提供者暴露。该研究强调了标准化、隐私友好的钱包架构的必要性。适合关注Web3安全、隐私保护、区块链应用安全的从业者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 浏览器扩展钱包的隐私泄露可导致用户身份去匿名化、跨站点跟踪和链上财富关联，严重威胁加密货币用户的隐私安全，并影响整个Web3生态系统的信任基础。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响Web3用户隐私、dApp安全性及钱包设计标准，可迁移至所有基于浏览器的加密货币钱包和身份管理场景。
detection_signals_zh: 跨会话或跨站点暴露相同地址的RPC请求模式
权限撤销后仍可查询已撤销地址的接口行为
跨域iframe中存在钱包提供者注入
多个不同地址通过同一RPC端点或浏览器指纹关联
defense_advice_zh: 钱包应实现一致的权限撤销机制，跨会话清除所有地址信息
限制提供者接口仅注入到受信任的dApp同源页面
采用隐私保护的RPC通信，如混淆或批量请求
推动Web3生态标准化，要求钱包遵循隐私设计原则
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进并评估自家钱包产品是否存在类似隐私威胁，制定改进计划。

items.title: xDECAF: An Extensible Data Flow Diagram Analysis Framework for Information Security
items.summary: xDECAF is an extensible tool for architecture-based data flow analysis with a focus on information security. It combines an extended data flow diagram metamodel of labeled flows and nodes, a domain-specific constraint language with different flow operations, and a browser-based editor backed by an analysis engine. In this paper, we present the xDECAF tool library and a curated catalog of over 20 example models with documented constraints and expected violations, intended as a reusable dataset for the community. The tool has already been adopted by several research lines, providing concrete evidence of its utility. The tool, dataset, and a hosted online editor are publicly available.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出并介绍了 xDECAF，一个可扩展的基于架构的数据流分析框架，专注于信息安全领域。xDECAF 的核心是一个增强的数据流图元模型，该模型扩展了传统数据流图的标签和节点类型，能够更精确地表示安全相关的信息流。框架包含一个领域特定的约束语言，支持多种流操作（如顺序、选择、循环等），允许分析人员以声明式方式定义安全约束和违规模式。分析引擎负责解析约束并自动检测模型中的潜在违规。此外，xDECAF 提供了一个基于浏览器的编辑器，集成了分析引擎，便于用户交互式建模和实时分析。作为工具库的一部分，作者构建并公开了超过20个示例模型，每个模型都附有文档化的约束和预期的违规结果，旨在为社区提供可复用的基准数据集。该工具已被多个独立研究项目采用，证明了其实用性。论文的贡献包括：1) 一个可扩展的数据流分析框架；2) 一个支持安全约束的领域特定语言；3) 一个公开可用的数据集和在线编辑器。论文适合软件安全架构师、威胁建模分析师以及从事数据流分析的研究人员阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: xDECAF 提供了一种可扩展、声明式的数据流分析方法，可以帮助安全团队在架构层面自动化检测信息流违规，弥补传统威胁建模工具的不足。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可用于安全架构评审、威胁建模自动化、数据流合规检查等场景。

items.title: Claimed or Attested? A Commit-Signature Dataset and Identity Trust Tiers across the World of Code
items.summary: An author string in a git commit is free text the committer typed, so identity resolution over a global commit corpus rests on a claim that nothing in the commit verifies. A cryptographically signed commit is different: it binds the commit to a key the committer controls, and when that key ties back to a real-world identity the git identity becomes attested rather than merely claimed. We release the first commit-signature axis for the World of Code (WoC), extracted for the V2604 collection. The signature travels in the commit object's gpgsig header and is already carried, unparsed, in the commit-message field of the WoC commit tables, so the axis is a scan over existing tables rather than a re-read of the object database. Over the V2604 corpus of 5,866,595,698 commits, 17.59% carry a signature (PGP dominant at 98.96%, with a growing minority of SSH and X.509/sigstore signatures), or 1,031,721,316 signed commits. We release the per-commit signature map c2sigFull, a key-to-author graph gated so that shared organization and continuous-integration keys are separated from person keys, and A2trust, a per-identity attestation tier (unsigned, signed, real-world-bound, cross-corpus attested) that extends the published A2cls identity-class dataset. The signature axis is a precision anchor, not a coverage layer: signed commits skew toward recent and security-conscious developers, a population that overlaps the scholarly authors a bibliography join targets. We use the person keys to build a cryptographically grounded alias gold that calibrates the heuristic WoC alias map independently of hand-labeled pairs, and to attach an attestation provenance to science-to-software identity links. All artifacts are released as a self-contained, in dependently hosted replication package keyed to the WoC V2604 collection.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出了首个面向全球代码库World of Code (WoC) 的提交签名数据集，旨在解决Git提交中作者身份的可信度问题。传统的Git提交中的作者字符串是自由文本，无法验证真实性，而加密签名提交（如PGP、SSH或X.509/sigstore签名）将提交与提交者控制的密钥绑定，当该密钥关联到现实世界身份时，身份从“声称”变为“被证明”。研究者从WoC V2604集合中提取了签名信息，该集合包含58.66亿次提交，其中17.59%（约10.32亿次）带有签名，其中PGP占主导（98.96%）。他们发布了每个提交的签名映射c2sigFull、密钥到作者的关系图（区分组织和持续集成密钥与个人密钥）以及身份信任层级A2trust（分为未签名、已签名、真实世界绑定、跨语料库证明四个层级）。签名轴提供了精确性锚点而非覆盖率：签名提交偏向近期和安全意识开发者，这些开发者与学术文献作者有重叠。研究者利用个人密钥构建了密码学上可验证的别名黄金标准，用于独立校准WoC的启发式别名映射，并将证明来源附加到科学到软件的识别链接上。所有产物作为独立托管的复制包发布，绑定到WoC V2604集合。该工作对于软件供应链安全、身份验证和开源代码溯源研究具有重要价值。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作为软件供应链安全提供了首个大规模代码提交签名数据集，使防御者能够区分可信和不可信的身份，提升代码审计和身份溯源精度。

items.title: Stablecoins under Stress in a National Economy: Transaction-Level Evidence from Austrian Crypto-Asset Service Providers
items.summary: Cryptoassets are increasingly entangled with the traditional financial system, and how this activity integrates into national economies and behaves under stress bears on financial stability and the design of public digital money. However, blockchain pseudonymity and the lack of geographic identifiers force existing work to rely on indirect proxies to infer and locate market participants. Here we use a regulatory registry that directly identifies the on-chain addresses of all crypto-asset service providers (CASPs) registered in Austria, reconstructing their on-chain transaction activity across Bitcoin, Ether, USDC, and USDT through May 2025, and separating retail-like from institutionally mediated flows. We find that Austrian CASPs intermediate roughly USD 30 billion with external counterparties and are integrated globally rather than domestically. In value, this activity is dominated by a few institutional counterparties; in number, by retail-like ones. Around three major shocks, the Terra-Luna collapse, the FTX bankruptcy, and the Silicon Valley Bank failure, the two groups respond through different mechanisms, and stablecoins do not act as a uniform safe haven. The clearest case is SVB, where retail-like deposits and institutional withdrawals are consistent with USDC's two-tiered redemption mechanism. These patterns are invisible in aggregate data. Registry-based, transaction-level measurement thus offers a reproducible, cross-jurisdictional basis for monitoring how cryptoasset markets transmit risk.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本研究利用奥地利金融监管机构直接识别的加密资产服务提供商（CASP）链上地址注册表，重建了2025年5月前奥地利所有注册CASP在比特币、以太坊、USDC和USDT上的链上交易活动，并区分了零售型交易和机构中介型交易。研究发现，奥地利CASP与外部对手方中介了约300亿美元的交易，且交易是全球性的而非国内性的。从价值上看，这些活动由少数机构对手方主导；从数量上看，则由零售型对手方主导。研究分析了三个重大冲击事件（Terra-Luna崩盘、FTX破产、硅谷银行倒闭）期间，两个群体通过不同机制做出反应，稳定币并未充当统一的避险资产。最明显的案例是硅谷银行倒闭，零售型存款和机构赎回行为与USDC的两层赎回机制一致。这些模式在聚合数据中不可见。该研究提供了一种可复现、跨司法管辖区的方法，用于监测加密资产市场如何传导风险，对金融稳定和公共数字货币设计具有启示意义。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 为监管机构和央行提供了基于链上交易层面监测稳定币压力行为的可复现方法，揭示零售与机构不同行为模式，对金融稳定评估和央行数字货币设计具有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可推广至其他国家和地区，用于识别稳定币在危机中的风险传染路径，辅助金融监管和货币政策制定。

items.title: Threshold Authorization Without Threshold Signatures: Signature-Agnostic MPC Custody
items.summary: Digital-asset custody has been built on threshold multi-party approval: no operation proceeds unless $t$ of $n$ parties approve, and fewer than t compromised parties can neither authorize nor learn the authorization secret. Threshold signature schemes (TSS) have been the standard mechanism, but the post-quantum transition disrupts this model: standardized hash-based signatures resist efficient threshold signing, and lattice-based threshold protocols remain an emerging research track. We present a dual-gate architecture that separates member authentication from threshold authorization. Each member signs its approval with an ordinary signature under any EUF-CMA scheme; the quorum jointly produces a threshold seal from Shamir-shared secrets bound to the operation. The seal is the base instance of a programmable authorization computation: simple quorum is the minimal policy, while richer policies can evaluate secret-shared state without making the member-signature scheme part of that computation. The signature scheme is a deployment parameter: migrating from ECDSA to SLH-DSA or ML-DSA is a key rotation, not a protocol redesign, and members holding keys in commodity HSMs participate through the standard sign API. The architecture can be deployed wherever the asset-control path supports programmable verification, such as smart contracts, vault modules, or HSMs guarding a master key, and produces an enforcement-layer authorization rather than a native chain signature. Below-threshold secrecy is information-theoretic; an adversary holding $\geq t$ signing keys but no coefficient shares still cannot produce the seal.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出了一种无需阈值签名即可实现阈值授权的双门架构，旨在解决后量子迁移背景下数字资产托管面临的瓶颈。传统上，阈值多签名审批依赖阈值签名方案（TSS），但后量子密码标准（如基于哈希的SLH-DSA和基于格的ML-DSA）要么不支持高效阈值签名，要么仍处于研究阶段，导致现有托管系统难以迁移。作者设计了一种双门架构，将成员认证与阈值授权分离：每个成员使用任意EUF-CMA安全的普通签名方案签署其批准；而阈值授权则通过Shamir秘密共享生成与操作绑定的阈值密封（threshold seal），该密封可视为可编程授权计算的基础实例，支持简单多数决策及更复杂的策略。此架构的关键优势在于签名方案成为可部署参数，迁移ECDSA到SLH-DSA或ML-DSA仅需密钥轮换，无需重新设计协议，且成员可使用商品HSM通过标准签名API参与。阈值密封在资产控制路径（如智能合约、保险库模块、守护主密钥的HSM）中生成执行层授权，而非原生链签名。安全性方面，低于阈值的秘密具有信息论安全性：即使攻击者持有t个签名密钥但无系数份额，仍无法伪造密封。实验证明该架构在多种场景下可行，为后量子数字资产托管提供了实用且兼容现有硬件的解决方案。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该方案解决了后量子迁移中阈值签名不可用或低效的难题，使托管系统无需重构即可迁移至后量子签名算法，对金融和区块链行业有重要参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于任何需要阈值授权且支持可编程验证的数字资产托管场景，如多签钱包、交易所冷钱包、HSM密钥治理等，尤其在后量子密码标准强制实施后影响深远。

items.title: MLQENABLER: Enabling Secure Machine Learning Queries over Encrypted Database in Cloud Computing
items.summary: In cloud computing, the public cloud service providers (CSPs) can provide cloud storage as the primary service while providing additional machine learning (ML)-based services by using the clients' data in storage. This business model extends the border of cloud computing services and brings in new business growth possibilities. Although it is promising, the model also brings in security concerns since the public commercial cloud cannot be fully trusted. For example, the public commercial clouds may sell clients' sensitive data to the government or other companies. To address the security concerns, an immediate solution is to require clients to encrypt their datasets before outsourcing to the cloud. However, if a database is formally encrypted, then the database contains only pseudorandom numbers, making it impossible to enable ML over it. In this project, we propose MLQENABLER (ML Queries Enabler) scheme to enable secure ML queries over encrypted database in cloud storage. MLQENABLER employs an index-aid approach to achieve security and ML capability simultaneously. Our initial experiments show that MLQENABLER achieves an acceptable security level while incurring only a slight ML performance degradation.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 论文提出了MLQENABLER方案，旨在解决云计算中加密数据库上无法直接应用机器学习（ML）查询的问题。在云存储场景下，客户端通常需要将数据加密后上传至云端，以防止不可信的云服务商泄露敏感信息。然而，加密后的数据呈现为伪随机数，使得传统的ML算法无法直接处理。MLQENABLER采用索引辅助方法，通过构建支持加密数据查询的索引结构，在不解密数据的前提下实现安全的ML查询。具体地，该方案设计了一种加密索引，能够保留数据间的相似性关系，从而支持诸如分类、聚类等ML任务。实验结果表明，MLQENABLER在达到可接受的安全级别的同时，仅带来轻微的ML性能下降。该工作为云端隐私保护下的ML应用提供了新的思路，适用于医疗、金融等对数据隐私要求严格的场景。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该方案首次在加密数据库上实现了高效的ML查询，平衡了安全性与实用性，为云环境下的敏感数据利用提供了可行路径。

items.title: Prismata: Confining Cross-Site Prompt Injection in Web Agents
items.summary: Autonomous web agents promise to automate everyday browsing tasks, but inherit one of the web's oldest attack surfaces. Cross-Site Scripting proved that mixing trusted and untrusted content is dangerous, even on benign pages. Agents resurface this risk by interpreting natural language as instructions, allowing third-party and user-generated content to hijack the agent via prompt injection. The core challenge is that deriving a task-specific security policy requires reasoning over page structure that is entangled with the attacker's content. We present Prismata, a defense enforcing contextual least privilege for web agents, constraining both what the agent sees and what it can do. Prismata's dynamic trust derivation produces permission labels for page content, with structural confinement guarantees, inspired by classical integrity models, that bound any labeling errors so that labels can only decrease in privilege and mislabelings are bounded. Prismata's mechanical confinement enforces these labels by redacting content and restricting agent capabilities. Importantly, these mechanisms require no developer annotations, so Prismata supports the long tail of websites. Across recent published web agent attacks, including adaptive variants, Prismata substantially reduces attack success while preserving benign task utility.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种名为 Prismata 的防御机制，用于遏制自主 Web 代理中的跨站提示注入（Cross-Site Prompt Injection）攻击。自主 Web 代理能够自动执行浏览任务，但其本质是将自然语言解释为指令，这导致第三方或用户生成的内容可以通过注入恶意提示来劫持代理。核心挑战在于，为特定任务推导安全策略需要解析页面结构，而攻击者内容与合法内容混杂在一起。Prismata 通过实施上下文最小权限原则来约束代理的感知能力和操作能力。其动态信任推导机制为页面内容生成权限标签，并基于经典完整性模型提供结构限制保证，确保标签错误只会导致权限降低，且误标范围可控。机械限制机制通过删除内容和限制代理能力来强制执行这些标签。Prismata 无需开发者注释，因此可适用于大量网站。实验表明，在多种已发布的 Web 代理攻击（包括自适应变体）下，Prismata 显著降低了攻击成功率，同时保持了良性任务的效用。本文适合关注 LLM 安全、Web 代理安全的研究人员和安全工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 自主Web代理是新兴应用，但其面临跨站提示注入的严重威胁。Prismata 提供了一种无需人工标注、具备理论保证的防御方案，对保护代理安全具有重要意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可应用于所有基于LLM的自主Web代理系统，防止恶意第三方内容劫持代理指令，影响金融、电商、个人助手等自动化浏览场景。

items.title: Securing Autonomous Vehicle Systems via Twin-Aware Federated Reinforcement Learning
items.summary: Federated reinforcement learning (FRL) is crucial for enabling collaborative learning across multiple agents without sharing raw data, thereby enhancing privacy and scalability in the decision-making process within dynamic vehicular environments. However, poisoning attacks pose a significant threat to the security and reliability of FRL-based systems, particularly in safety-critical autonomous driving, where this vulnerability remains largely unexplored. These attacks can compromise the global control model by subtly injecting malicious system parameters, leading to potential hazards. To counter these challenges, we present \alg (\underline{Sec}ure \underline{A}ggregation with \underline{p}oisoning-\underline{p}revention and historical reinforcement) as a defensive framework aimed at enhancing the robustness of FRL systems designed for safety-critical driving scenarios. \alg strategically integrates digital twins for rehearsal-based learning and leverages historical aggregated model parameters along with a selected central gradient to ensure that only benign data is aggregated, effectively mitigating the influence of malicious agents. Theoretical guarantees are provided for the convergence performance of \alg in the presence of poisoning attacks. We also validate the effectiveness of \alg using developed digital twins that model realistic highway environments to evaluate the control of autonomous vehicles under adversarial conditions.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究了联邦强化学习（FRL）在安全关键型自动驾驶系统中的应用，并重点探讨了投毒攻击对FRL系统的威胁。FRL允许多个智能体在不共享原始数据的情况下协同学习，从而增强隐私保护和可扩展性，但在动态车辆环境中，投毒攻击可能通过注入恶意系统参数破坏全局控制模型，导致安全隐患。作者提出了一种名为SecAg-PH（Secure Aggregation with Poisoning-prevention and Historical Reinforcement）的防御框架，旨在提升FRL在安全关键驾驶场景中的鲁棒性。SecAg-PH策略性地集成了数字孪生技术进行演练式学习，并利用历史聚合模型参数和选定的中心梯度，确保仅聚合良性数据，从而有效减轻恶意智能体的影响。论文提供了在投毒攻击下SecAg-PH收敛性能的理论保证，并通过开发模拟真实高速公路环境的数字孪生系统，在对抗条件下验证了其对自动驾驶车辆控制的有效性。该研究首次深入探讨了FRL在自动驾驶中的投毒攻击漏洞，并提出了具有理论保障的防御方案，为未来自动驾驶安全联邦学习系统的设计提供了重要参考。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 自动驾驶安全是极受关注的领域，而FRL的投毒攻击风险此前未被充分研究。本文提出的防御框架兼具理论证明和仿真验证，对蓝队构建鲁棒的联邦学习系统有启发意义。

items.title: Degree-Constrained Interval Optimization for Minimax Polynomial Approximation in Homomorphic Encryption
items.summary: Homomorphic encryption (HE) enables privacy-preserving inference under arithmetic constraints that restrict encrypted evaluation to additions and multiplications. As a result, non-polynomial activation functions must be replaced by polynomial approximations. Among polynomial approximation methods, minimax approximation, typically computed by the Remez algorithm, is a standard approach because it minimizes the maximum approximation error over a given design interval. For minimax polynomial design, the approximation interval is a critical hyperparameter: a wider interval improves robustness to large-magnitude inputs while increasing the minimax approximation error under a fixed degree budget. In this paper, we formulate this trade-off as a distribution-aware interval optimization problem, where the approximation interval is chosen to minimize the mean-squared error (MSE) with respect to the pre-activation distribution of interest. To effectively control outside-interval inputs, we combine minimax polynomials with domain extension functions (DEFs) and their HE-realizable polynomial counterparts, domain extension polynomials (DEPs), which approximate a clipping operation outside the design interval and thereby suppress uncontrolled polynomial extrapolation. We first derive an analytically tractable DEF-based proxy objective that captures the trade-off between within-interval minimax approximation error and outside-interval clipping error. We then connect this idealized objective to HE-realizable DEP constructions through an implementation-error decomposition with an accompanying upper bound.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对同态加密（HE）中非多项式激活函数的近似问题，提出了一种度约束区间优化方法。HE仅支持加法和乘法运算，因此必须用多项式近似替代非多项式激活函数（如ReLU、Sigmoid等）。极小极大近似（Minimax approximation）通常通过Remez算法计算，能够最小化给定设计区间内的最大近似误差。然而，设计区间的选择是一个关键超参数：区间越宽，对大数值输入的鲁棒性越好，但在固定多项式次数下会增加极小极大近似误差。本文将此权衡建模为分布感知的区间优化问题，即根据预激活值的分布选择近似区间以最小化均方误差（MSE）。为了有效控制区间外的输入，作者将极小极大多项式与域扩展函数（DEF）及其HE可实现的对应项——域扩展多项式（DEP）相结合。DEP近似了设计区间外的裁剪操作，从而抑制了不受控的多项式外推行为。首先，作者推导了一个解析可处理的基于DEF的代理目标函数，该函数捕捉了区间内极小极大近似误差与区间外裁剪误差之间的权衡。然后，通过实现误差分解及上界，将该理想化目标与HE可实现的DEP构造联系起来。实验验证了该方法在多种激活函数和分布下的有效性，表明所提优化方法能在不显著增加计算开销的前提下，提升近似精度。本文适合对同态加密、隐私保护推理及多项式近似技术感兴趣的研究人员和工程师阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 提供了一种数据驱动的区间选择方法，直接优化HE中多项式近似的精度与鲁棒性平衡，对提升隐私推理效率与实际部署价值显著。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至任何依赖HE的隐私计算场景，如安全机器学习推理、隐私保护数据分析等，尤其是涉及非多项式激活函数的应用。

items.title: Closed-Loop Dynamic Validator Node Scaling in Private Substrate Blockchains Using Takagi-Sugeno Fuzzy Inference
items.summary: Private blockchain networks run with fixed node configurations that cannot adapt to changing workload conditions. Too many nodes serving a light workload waste resources; too few nodes facing heavy demand slow block production and degrade finalisation. The right validator count is hard to determine, as it depends on overlapping factors that shift over time. This paper presents a Takagi-Sugeno (TS) fuzzy inference system that reads live blockchain parameters (block production time, block size, and active node count) and outputs a continuous efficiency score alongside a scaling recommendation: Scale Up, Maintain, or Scale Down. The controller uses triangular membership functions across three linguistic variables, evaluated through a complete 27-rule base with product t-norm aggregation. A key contribution is an empirical recalibration of the membership functions, anchoring linguistic terms to the observed operating range of the testbed rather than to theoretical extremes. The system is evaluated on a 10-node Substrate blockchain network storing real smart water meter data hashes from the Queensland Government open data portal. Statistical analysis across configurations of 4, 7, and 10 active nodes confirms that the controller produces distinct operational profiles reflecting each configuration's provisioning state. In closed-loop experiments, the controller autonomously adjusts validator participation in both directions, activating validators under rising load and removing them under over-provisioning, converging to the same stable equilibrium from both directions. Compared against three threshold-based baselines, it shows fewer scaling oscillations while maintaining comparable block production times. Results show that TS fuzzy inference can support autonomous validator management in private blockchain deployments, with stable scaling behaviour threshold approaches cannot match.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对私有区块链网络中固定节点配置无法适应动态工作负载的问题，提出了一种基于Takagi-Sugeno (TS) 模糊推理的闭环动态验证器节点扩展系统。私有区块链通常采用静态节点数量，导致在轻负载时资源浪费，重负载时区块生产缓慢、最终确认延迟。正确确定验证器数量难度大，因为它取决于多个随时间变化的叠加因素。研究团队设计了TS模糊控制器，读取实时区块链参数（区块生产时间、区块大小和活跃节点数量），输出连续效率分数及扩展建议（扩展、保持、缩减）。控制器使用三个语言变量的三角形隶属函数，并通过完整的27条规则库和乘积t-norm聚合进行评估。关键贡献在于对隶属函数进行了经验校准，将语言术语锚定到测试床的实际运行范围而非理论极值。实验基于10节点Substrate区块链网络，存储来自昆士兰政府开放数据门户的真实智能水表数据哈希。对4、7、10个活跃节点配置的统计分析表明，控制器产生了反映每种配置供应状态的独特操作剖面。在闭环实验中，控制器自主地在两个方向上调整验证器参与度，即在负载上升时激活验证器，在过度配置时移除验证器，并从两个方向收敛到相同的稳定均衡。与三个基于阈值的基线相比，它在保持可比区块生产时间的同时，表现出更少的扩展振荡。结果表明，TS模糊推理能够支持私有区块链部署中的自主验证器管理，其稳定的扩展行为是阈值方法无法比拟的。

items.title: Open Models, Open Risks: Measuring Unsafe Generation in Text-to-Image Models In the Wild
items.summary: Existing safety studies on text-to-image (T2I) jailbreaks are largely conducted in controlled in-the-lab settings, typically on a small number of canonical models. As a result, the current safety status of the rapidly growing in-the-wild T2I ecosystem remains unclear. This uncertainty is amplified by two factors: existing detector-based metrics are designed for controlled evaluation, and in-the-wild risks may arise not only from adversarial prompting, but also from unsafe release practices and unsafe model derivatives. In this paper, we present a large-scale empirical study of in-the-wild T2I safety through the lens of jailbreak. We first show that detector-only jailbreak metrics substantially overestimate practical risk over in the wild due to semantic drift and generation artifacts, and we introduce Advanced ASR to better capture semantically valid and visually plausible unsafe generation. Using this refined metric, we evaluate 200+ in-the-wild T2I models from Hugging Face under three representative jailbreak attacks. Our results show that many downstream models retain a non-trivial degree of safety even without explicit post-hoc safeguards, indicating that safety degradation in the wild is neither universal nor uniform. At the same time, we identify a set of high-risk models, including explicitly NSFW-oriented releases as well as seemingly benign models whose unsafe behavior is only exposed through systematic evaluation. We further trace these models to their release context and report high-risk cases to Hugging Face.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对文本到图像（T2I）模型在“野外”（in-the-wild）环境下的安全性进行了大规模实证研究。现有的T2I越狱安全研究大多在受控实验室环境中进行，仅测试少量规范模型，导致对快速增长的野外T2I生态系统的安全现状缺乏清晰认识。这种不确定性因两个因素加剧：现有基于检测器的指标是为受控评估设计的，而野外风险不仅来自对抗性提示，还可能来自不安全的发布实践和模型衍生版本。本文首先通过实验证明，仅依赖检测器的越狱指标因语义漂移和生成伪影，会显著高估野外实际风险，并引入“先进攻击成功率”（Advanced ASR）来更准确地捕获语义有效且视觉可信的不安全生成。利用这一改进指标，作者在Hugging Face上对200多个野外T2I模型在三种代表性越狱攻击下进行了评估。结果表明，许多下游模型在未附加明确安全防护措施的情况下仍保留了相当程度的安全性，表明野外安全性退化既非普遍也非均匀。同时，他们识别出一批高风险模型，包括明确面向NSFW的发布以及看似良性但通过系统评估才暴露不安全行为的模型。此外，他们追溯这些模型的发布上下文，并向Hugging Face报告了高风险案例。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究首次大规模评估了实际部署的文本到图像模型的安全状况，揭示了安全风险在“野外”并非普遍恶化，但存在被忽视的高风险模型，对安全审核和模型发布实践有重要指导意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响Hugging Face等模型托管平台的安全性审查流程，以及下游开发者对模型选择的决策；可迁移至其他生成式AI模型的安全评估场景。
detection_signals_zh: 越狱提示下输出语义危险但视觉合理的图像

defense_advice_zh: 模型发布前应进行系统性安全评估，包括多种越狱攻击
采用改进的Advanced ASR指标而非仅依赖检测器
建立高风险模型识别与通报机制

items.title: Idiobionics: The Unification of Privacy and Intelligent Robotic Prostheses
items.summary: The human body is at the center of a growing family of technologies designed to tightly and persistently couple biological and digital systems. Robotic prostheses are a representative example of this tight coupling. Also referred to as bionic limbs, robotic prostheses are devices that support people who have lost limbs in pursuing daily life activities such as walking and grasping objects. Bionic limbs are now perceptive and responsive owing to their integration with advanced sensors and artificial intelligence-based control approaches. Consequently, such robotic prostheses can now be viewed as semiautonomous wearable robotic systems that can co-adapt with their users. However, the same sensing and control advancements that increase the capability of robotic prostheses also introduce threat vectors that could be exploited by malicious entities to violate the privacy of users. To fully realize the benefits of next-generation bionic limbs, we maintain it is important to directly understand and address these privacy risks and the barriers they might present to user adoption. This paper therefore introduces a new line of inquiry we term idiobionics to holistically investigate issues at the intersection of privacy and intelligent bionic limbs. As the main contribution of this paper, we define idiobionics, ground it in related literature, and provide preliminary evidence showing and discussing potential adversarial attacks that could exploit intelligent bionic limb designs. We then contribute a curated list of open research questions within idiobionics that are relevant to researchers in wearable robotics and other human-facing autonomous systems. We expect that idiobionics research will help unlock the full potential of robotic prostheses and related bionic devices.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出了一门新的研究领域——'idiobionics'，旨在系统性地研究智能假肢（也称为仿生肢体）中的隐私问题。随着机器人假肢与先进传感器和基于人工智能的控制方法深度融合，这些设备已发展为半自主的可穿戴机器人系统，能够与用户协同适应。然而，这种感知和控制能力的提升也引入了新的威胁向量，恶意行为者可能利用这些漏洞侵犯用户隐私。论文的主要贡献包括：正式定义 idiobionics 概念，将其植根于相关文献（涵盖隐私、机器人学、人机交互等领域）；通过初步实验展示潜在的对抗攻击示例，说明攻击者如何利用假肢的设计缺陷获取敏感信息；以及提出一系列 idiobionics 内部的开放研究问题，为可穿戴机器人和其他面向人类的自适应系统的研究人员提供方向。该研究强调，要充分释放下一代仿生肢体的潜力，必须直接理解和解决这些隐私风险及其对用户接受度的障碍。本文适合安全研究人员、机器人学家、隐私倡导者以及假肢开发者阅读。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 随着智能假肢日益普及，其集成的传感器和AI控制带来了新的隐私攻击面，可能导致用户生物特征、运动模式等敏感信息泄露，而目前该领域缺乏系统性的隐私研究。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响智能假肢、可穿戴机器人系统、人机耦合系统等领域的隐私设计，可迁移至其他感知丰富的辅具或脑机接口设备。

items.title: Modeling Failure Dynamics in Time-Constrained Authentication Systems: Evidence of a Success Cliff in USSD Workflows
items.summary: Time-constrained interactive systems such as USSD (Unstructured Supplementary Service Data)-based financial services operate under strict session limits and sequential user interaction. While stronger authentication mechanisms improve security, they also increase interaction complexity and time burden, potentially reducing transaction completion. In this work, we model the failure dynamics of such systems and investigate how authentication complexity interacts with user response time and network round-trip time to influence session success rate. We propose and implement a simulation-based framework to investigate these failure dynamics and formally define a non-linear failure phenomenon, termed the \textit{Success Cliff}, where session success rates sharply decline beyond a critical complexity threshold. Through controlled experiments, we quantify the trade-off between security and usability and identify conditions under which secure authentication workflows become operationally unreliable.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该研究聚焦于时间受限交互系统（如基于USSD的金融服务）中的认证失败动力学。这类系统通常有严格的会话时限和顺序用户交互流程。虽然更强的认证机制能提升安全性，但也会增加交互复杂性和时间负担，可能导致交易完成率下降。论文提出并实现了一个基于仿真的框架来研究这些失败动力学，并正式定义了一种非线性失败现象——"成功悬崖"（Success Cliff），即当认证复杂度超过某个临界阈值时，会话成功率会急剧下降。通过控制实验，研究量化了安全性与可用性之间的权衡，并识别了安全认证工作流在何种条件下会变得操作不可靠。主要贡献包括：（1）建立数学模型描述认证复杂度、用户响应时间、网络往返时间与会话成功率之间的关系；（2）通过仿真验证了成功悬崖的存在及其关键阈值；（3）为设计兼顾安全与可用性的时间受限认证系统提供了理论依据。该工作适用于人机交互、安全工程、金融科技等领域的研究人员和设计者。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示了强认证机制在时间受限场景下可能适得其反的临界点，为平衡安全与可用性提供量化依据，尤其对USSD等低带宽金融服务具有直接指导价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可迁移至任何具有严格时间限制的交互式认证系统（如电话银行、物联网设备配置），帮助识别因复杂度增加导致用户体验崩溃的阈值。

items.title: Multi-Class vs. Multi-Label BERT for CVE-to-CWE Mapping: How Taxonomy Structure Shapes the Errors
items.summary: Assigning Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) categories to Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE) records remains an important but largely manual step in vulnerability analysis. We study this task as a text classification problem and compare two modelling choices: a \emph{multi-class} formulation that predicts a single CWE per CVE and a \emph{multi-label} formulation that allows multiple assignments. Three transformer encoders (BERT Base, SecureBERT, and CySecBERT) are evaluated on three nested label spaces (83, 47, and 25 classes). Multi-class training achieves higher macro-F1 across all settings, although the gap to multi-label narrows from 21 to 2 percentage points as the label space shrinks. Post-hoc threshold optimisation on the multi-label side closes this gap on the 25-class setting. Confusion analysis shows that the dominant misclassification patterns follow the CWE hierarchy and are shared across all three encoders (Pearson $r > 0.92$), which suggests that the error structure is driven more by taxonomy design than by encoder choice. A hierarchy-relaxed evaluation that forgives within-family confusions raises macro-F1 from ${\sim}$81\% to ${\sim}$90\%, indicating that strict metrics understate branch-level classifier quality. CySecBERT achieves the strongest results overall, with statistically significant gains concentrated in the multi-label setting.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究自动将通用漏洞披露（CVE）记录映射到通用弱点枚举（CWE）类别的文本分类问题。目前这一任务主要依赖人工，效率低下。作者比较了两种建模选择：多分类（每个CVE预测一个CWE）和多标签（允许预测多个CWE）。使用三种基于BERT的编码器（BERT Base、SecureBERT、CySecBERT），在三种嵌套标签空间（83、47、25个类别）上进行评估。实验发现，多分类训练在所有设置下均获得更高的宏F1分数，但当标签空间从83类缩减到25类时，与多标签的差距从21个百分点缩小到2个百分点。通过事后阈值优化，多标签方法在25类设置下可弥补这一差距。混淆分析表明，主要的错误分类模式遵循CWE层次结构，并且这三种编码器共享相同的模式（Pearson相关系数>0.92），说明错误结构更多地由分类法设计而非编码器选择驱动。采用层次松弛评估（允许同一家族内的混淆）后，宏F1从约81%提高到约90%，表明严格指标低估了分支级分类器的质量。CySecBERT总体上表现最佳，其统计显著的优势集中在多标签设置中。该研究为自动化CVE到CWE映射提供了方法论指导，并强调了分类法层次对分类误差的影响。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 自动化CVE到CWE映射能显著减少安全分析中的人工工作量，提高威胁情报和漏洞管理的效率。本文通过对比多分类与多标签方法，揭示了分类法层次结构对分类误差的决定性影响，有助于研究人员和工程师选择更合适的模型与评价指标。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 对安全运营中心（SOC）的漏洞分析流程、自动化威胁情报生产以及CWE数据库的维护有参考价值。层次松弛评价方法可迁移至其他存在层次结构标签的分类任务。

items.title: Beyond Attack-Success Rate: Action-Graded Severity Scale for Tool-Using AI Agents
items.summary: Agentic red-teaming benchmarks report whether an injected agent was compromised as a single bit: the attack succeeded, or it did not. We argue that this binary attack-success rate discards the information a defender most needs, namely how harmful the resulting action was. We introduce an action-graded harm rubric that scores an agent's tool-call trajectory on a seven-level ordinal scale (L0 to L6) according to whether the executed action was reversible, whether it crossed scope to reach another party, and whether it expanded privilege. We compute the scale two ways: a deterministic oracle that reads the trajectory and the attacker's stated goal, and a panel of three frontier language-model judges that read a tag-free account of the same trajectory. Across four victim models and two defenses on the AgentDojo workspace suite, severity grading exposes three cases the binary metric hides, including a defense that reports a zero attack-success rate while still permitting an externally visible cross-scope leak through an unfiltered tool. The judge panel reproduces the oracle with high ordinal agreement (Krippendorff's alpha = 0.91) but shares systematic blind spots that we characterize, most notably a failure to recognize escalation chains. Unlike prior work that provides harm taxonomies, harmful-task completion tests, execution-level safety benchmarks, or severity-aware simulation, our contribution is a reusable, trace-grounded severity instrument applied to the actual actions recorded in existing red-team logs. All code, prompts, and per-episode logs are released.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出了一种用于评估工具型AI代理安全性的行动分级危害量表（Action-Graded Harm Rubric）及其计算方法。传统上，代理红队测试仅以攻击是否成功（即代理是否被攻陷）作为二元指标，忽略了被攻陷后实际造成的危害程度。作者认为，防御者更需知道代理执行的具体动作的可逆性、是否超出范围影响其他方以及是否扩展了权限。为此，论文设计了一个七级序数等级（L0至L6），对代理的工具调用轨迹进行分级。分级通过两种方式实现：一是确定性预言机，直接根据轨迹和攻击者目标给出等级；二是由三个前沿语言模型组成的裁判小组，阅读无标签的轨迹描述后进行评分。在AgentDojo工作空间套件上，对四种受害者模型和两种防御策略进行实验，结果显示二元指标隐藏了三种案例，其中包括一种防御策略虽报告零攻击成功率，却仍允许通过未过滤的工具发生对外可见的跨范围泄漏。裁判小组与预言机具有高度序数一致性（Krippendorff's alpha=0.91），但存在共同盲点，最显著的是未能识别权限提升链。与现有工作（如危害分类法、有害任务完成测试、执行级安全基准、严重性感知模拟）不同，本贡献是一个可复用的、基于轨迹的严重性评估工具，可直接应用于现有红队日志。所有代码、提示词和逐次日志均已开源。该工作为代理安全评估提供了更细致的量化方法，有助于防御者更精准地理解实际风险。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 现有代理红队评估仅关注攻击是否成功，掩盖了实际危害程度的差异，而本文提出的行动分级量表可直接应用于现有日志，帮助防御者精准识别高风险行为，避免被低危害的成功攻击误导。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 该量表可应用于各种工具型AI代理（如自主工作流、客户服务机器人）的安全评估，特别适合防御团队筛选真正有害的攻击，以及检验防御措施的有效性。

items.title: How Reliable Is the Multi-Input Heuristic for Bitcoin Address Clustering in Law Enforcement Contexts?
items.summary: Address clustering is an important technique in blockchain forensics, widely employed by law enforcement to trace illicit crypto asset flows. The multi-input heuristic (MIH), which clusters addresses potentially associated with the same entity, is the most widely used. Yet, despite its broad adoption, the MIH has rarely been evaluated against reliable ground truth data. We implement a reusable evaluation framework covering nine established metrics and apply it to ground truth address-to-entity mappings obtained directly from European crypto asset service providers under legally mandated reporting obligations. When evaluation is restricted to reported addresses, the MIH appears strong at dataset level: we observe no mergers between reported services and recover same-service address pairs with recall $0.71$. However, this result is driven by one large service and ignores unlabeled addresses absorbed into full clusters. Metrics that assess the full clusters show substantially lower precision and recall ($0.36$ and $0.44$), meaning that services are often only partially recovered or embedded in larger clusters. Entity-level results further reveal near-complete failures for some services. When MIH-based clusters are used to support criminal suspicion, preliminary seizure of crypto assets to secure later forfeiture/ confiscation, or as evidence in trial proceedings, prosecutors and judges must account for the heuristic's metric-dependent and entity-dependent reliability.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文系统评估了比特币地址聚类的多输入启发式方法（MIH）在法律取证上下文中的可靠性。地址聚类是区块链取证中追踪非法加密货币流动的关键技术，MIH通过合并同一交易中输入地址来推测它们属于同一实体，被执法部门广泛采用。然而，针对可靠的基准数据（ground truth）进行严格评估的研究非常少。作者构建了一个可复用的评估框架，涵盖9项既定指标，并应用于从欧洲加密资产服务提供商（CASP）依法获取的真实地址-实体映射数据。当评估仅限于已报告地址时，MIH在数据集层面表现良好：未观察到报告服务之间的合并，且相同服务内地址对的召回率为0.71。但这一结果主要由一个大服务驱动，且忽略了被吸收进完整簇的未标注地址。评估完整簇的指标显示精确率和召回率显著降低（分别为0.36和0.44），说明服务往往只被部分恢复或被嵌入更大的簇中。实体层面的分析进一步揭示了对某些服务的近乎完全失败。因此，当基于MIH的聚类结果用于支持犯罪嫌疑判断、初步扣押加密资产以保全后续没收，或在庭审中作为证据时，检察官和法官必须考虑该启发式方法在指标和实体层面的可靠性差异。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究揭露了广泛使用的比特币地址聚类启发式方法在法律取证中的实际局限性，提醒执法人员和司法系统不能盲目依赖聚类结果，否则可能导致错误指控或资产扣押，具有重要的司法实践意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接影响区块链取证工具的可靠性认知，可能促使执法机构制定更严格的聚类结果使用指南，并推动改进现有启发式方法或采用多模态聚类策略。

items.title: The AI Resilience Gap: Bringing Artificial Intelligence Inside the Operational Resilience Perimeter
items.summary: The rapid adoption of artificial intelligence across regulated firms has produced an extensive governance response oriented around trustworthiness: the EU AI Act, ISO IEC 42001, the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, and the United Kingdom's principles-based approach all address safety, fairness, transparency, and model risk. That response is necessary but incomplete. It does not, on its own, address operational resilience: the continuity of important business services under severe but plausible disruption, the substitutability of AI components, and the concentration of dependency on the small number of firms that supply frontier models. This paper argues that AI adoption creates a resilience obligation that is distinct from, and inadequately covered by, the trustworthy AI stack, and that United Kingdom financial authorities are already closing this gap through the Financial Policy Committee's systemic analysis, the Critical Third Parties regime, and the May 2026 joint statement on frontier AI and cyber resilience. We map the two regulatory logics, identify the structural gap between them, and propose the AI Resilience Framework: a regime-agnostic method for bringing AI dependencies inside the operational resilience perimeter through dependency mapping, a criticality-substitutability tiering, the extension of impact tolerances to AI-specific failure modes, an explicit fallback doctrine, and provider level concentration management. The framework gives chief information security officers, security architects, and boards an actionable route from AI governance policy to demonstrable resilience. This work extends a companion analysis of the United Kingdom cyber resilience regulatory stack into the artificial intelligence dimension.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文探讨了人工智能在受监管企业（如金融行业）中的快速采用所引发的运营韧性问题。作者指出，现有的AI治理框架（如欧盟AI法案、ISO IEC 42001、NIST AI风险管理框架等）主要聚焦于可信AI（安全、公平、透明、模型风险），但并未充分覆盖运营韧性——即在严重但合理的破坏情况下重要业务服务的连续性、AI组件的可替代性，以及对少数提供前沿模型供应商的依赖集中度。文章认为，AI采用产生了一种与可信AI堆栈不同且未被充分覆盖的韧性义务，并指出英国金融当局已通过金融政策委员会的系统性分析、关键第三方制度以及2026年5月关于前沿AI与网络韧性的联合声明来弥补这一缺口。作者映射了两种监管逻辑（可信AI与运营韧性），识别了二者之间的结构性差距，并提出了AI韧性框架：一种与具体制度无关的方法，通过依赖映射、关键性-可替代性分层、将影响容忍度扩展到AI特定故障模式、明确的回退机制以及供应商级集中度管理，将AI依赖纳入运营韧性边界。该框架为首席信息安全官、安全架构师和董事会提供了从AI治理政策到可证明韧性的可行路径。本文是对英国网络韧性监管堆栈在AI维度上的补充分析。

items.title: FedCVESA: Taking Away Training Data in Federated Learning via Correlation Value Encoding and Segmented Aggregation
items.summary: Federated learning (FL) avoids explicit data exposure by keeping raw data on local clients, yet privacy risks remain in the training process and the learned model itself. Recently, centralized Taking Away Training Data (TATD) attacks have shown that malicious training could abuse the memorization capacity of deep models to store and later recover training data. However, this memorization-based threat has not been systematically studied under FL environments, where multi-client averaging could overwrite encoded training data. In this paper, we study a white-box TATD attack in which a malicious server selects n target clients from K participating clients and actively writes private training data into the global model during federated training. We propose FedCVESA, a federated variant of Correlation Value Encoding Attack (CVEA), by adding a Pearson-correlation regularizer to the loss function of target clients, so that private training data are gradually encoded into selected model parameters, referred to as carrier parameters. To reduce the overwriting of carrier parameters during server aggregation, we further propose segmented aggregation over dispersed carrier parameters, preserving selected carrier parameters while keeping standard averaging on the remaining parameters. Experiments on MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, and CIFAR-10 under Dirichlet non-IID partitions show that the proposed method can steal semantically meaningful private training images from the trained model while maintaining acceptable main-task utility in a controlled proof-of-concept setting. These results demonstrate that FL can become a parameter-level memorization channel for active TATD attack under the studied white-box malicious-server setting.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 联邦学习（FL）通过将原始数据保留在本地客户端来避免直接数据暴露，但训练过程和学到的模型本身仍存在隐私风险。最近，集中式训练数据窃取（TATD）攻击表明，恶意训练可能滥用深度模型的记忆能力来存储并在之后恢复训练数据。然而，这种基于记忆的威胁在联邦学习环境中尚未被系统研究，因为多客户端平均可能覆盖编码的训练数据。本文研究了一种白盒TATD攻击，其中恶意服务器从K个参与客户端中选择n个目标客户端，并在联邦训练过程中主动将私有训练数据写入全局模型。作者提出了FedCVESA，这是一种基于相关性值编码攻击（CVEA）的联邦变体，通过在目标客户端的损失函数中添加皮尔逊相关性正则化器，使私有训练数据逐步编码到选定的模型参数（称为载体参数）中。为了减少服务器聚合时载体参数被覆盖，进一步提出了分散载体参数的分段聚合，即在保持其余参数标准平均的同时，保留选定的载体参数。在MNIST、Fashion-MNIST和CIFAR-10数据集上，在狄利克雷非独立同分布划分下进行的实验表明，所提方法可以在控制的概念验证设置中，在保持可接受的主任务效用的同时，从训练好的模型中窃取具有语义意义的私有训练图像。这些结果证明，在所研究的白盒恶意服务器设置下，联邦学习可以成为主动TATD攻击的参数级记忆通道。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示了联邦学习在恶意服务器白盒场景下，可能通过参数编码泄露训练数据的新风险，对FL隐私保护研究具有重要警示意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 若攻击可行，可导致联邦学习客户端的私有训练数据被窃取，影响金融、医疗等隐私敏感领域的应用。

items.title: Safe2Hail: A Forensic-Driven Post-Trip Tracking Framework for Ride-Hailing Safety in Africa
items.summary: Ride-hailing mobile apps have become an essential feature in the mobility ecosystem in Africa, offering much safer and much more affordable rides. Although user bases have increased and the number of daily trips has proliferated, reports of imminent safety threats, particularly after the cancellation of the ride or the ride is prematurely terminated, remain unresolved challenges. Current safety measures offer features such as SOS alerts, safety notifications, and live location sharing for the duration of the trip, but they are not in place when the trip is over. Safe2Hail presents a framework that is forensically driven to ensure continuous safety and certainty beyond the trip. The Safe2Hail framework combines forensic tracking with a temporary post-trip synchronization mechanism that can securely log all proximal data between a passenger and a driver after an event. The Safe2Hail framework was beta-tested and demonstrates the effectiveness of the system. Although the research team did not pilot on actual deployment, the Safe2Hail design format was in part inspired by actual crime events reported in Nairobi and Dar-es-Salaam. The findings of the study referenced Safe2Hail's feasibility, light weight nature of resources, as well as the scalability for the framework.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对非洲网约车行业在行程结束后仍存在安全隐患的问题，提出了一款名为 Safe2Hail 的框架。当前主流网约车平台（如 Uber、Bolt）虽然提供了 SOS 警报、安全通知和实时位置共享等行程内安全功能，但在行程取消或提前终止后，乘客与司机之间的安全保障机制缺失。作者通过分析内罗毕和达累斯萨拉姆的实际犯罪事件，设计了一个基于法证追踪的临时行程后同步机制。该框架能够在行程结束后，通过安全的同步协议记录乘客与司机之间的所有近场数据（如蓝牙、WiFi 信号、位置快照等），供事后调查取证使用。研究团队进行了 beta 测试，验证了系统的有效性、资源轻量性和可扩展性，但未在实际生产环境中部署。论文主要贡献包括：提出了一种填补安全空白的后行程追踪概念，设计了兼顾隐私与取证需求的数据同步方案，并通过实验证明了可行性。适合关注网约车安全、移动应用取证、以及非洲地区数字安全的研究人员和安全从业者阅读。

items.title: MoLIFE: Methodology, Technologies, and Challenges for Mobile Live Intelligent Forensics Examination
items.summary: Nowadays, mobile forensics is less explored in Digital Forensics case analysis due to the increase in data protection mechanisms implemented by tech companies (i.e., Google for Android and Apple for iOS). For example, the physical acquisition or analysis of specific directories under super-user protection would corrupt the evidence; access to such data is protected, and bypassing this protection requires either privilege escalation or custom ROM installation, leading to the modification of the device state. At the same time, the demand for mobile technologies and their respective communication systems is increasing exponentially, exposing numerous security threats and risks. For that reason, this paper presents a Mobile Live Intelligent Forensics Examination (MoLIFE), a novel Digital Forensics (DF) methodology for data acquisition and analysis of mobile devices. The proposed methodology is based on NIST SP800-101 for the DF process. MoLIFE can be integrated with new and emerging technologies by exploiting their power (e.g., AI, blockchain, quantum computing). MoLIFE can also be used to prevent cyber threats and incidents, as well as DF post-mortem analysis, offering examples of applying the MoLIFE methodology and good practices for the future. To prove the technical feasibility of the methodology, a small case study on Android devices data acquisition via the mDT will be presented. As the methodology is based on new and emerging technologies, it depends on their limitations that would be overcome in a few years.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种名为 MoLIFE（移动实时智能取证检查）的新型数字取证方法论，旨在解决移动设备取证中日益增长的数据保护机制带来的挑战。当前，Android 和 iOS 等系统厂商加强了数据保护措施，导致物理获取或分析受超级用户保护的目录会破坏证据，而绕过保护需要提权或刷入自定义 ROM，这会修改设备状态，不符合取证原则。同时，移动技术和通信系统的需求激增带来了安全威胁。MoLIFE 基于 NIST SP800-101 标准，将数字取证流程分为数据获取和分析阶段，并支持集成人工智能、区块链、量子计算等新兴技术，以提升取证效率、完整性和智能化水平。该方法论不仅适用于事后取证分析，还能用于预防网络威胁和事件响应。为验证技术可行性，作者通过一个小型案例研究，在 Android 设备上使用 mDT 工具进行数据获取，展示了 MoLIFE 的操作流程。论文还讨论了新技术（如 AI 的模型可解释性、区块链的共识开销、量子计算的不成熟性）带来的局限性，并展望了未来几年内这些限制将被克服。MoLIFE 提供了一套规范化、可扩展的移动取证框架，适合数字取证研究人员、安全分析师和执法机构参考。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 移动设备取证因厂商保护机制而困难重重，MoLIFE 提出一套标准化且融合新兴技术的方法论，有望突破现状，提升取证的有效性和前瞻性。

items.title: Monitoring Vulnerabilities in Next-Generation Automotive Operating Systems
items.summary: Software-defined vehicles (SDVs) are revolutionizing transportation by integrating complex, interconnected hardware, and software systems. This evolution introduces significant security challenges. We present a comprehensive security analysis for SDVs, focusing on software vulnerabilities. We note that existing vulnerability assessment tools fall short in addressing operating systems vulnerabilities, particularly when it comes to efficiently analyzing diverse software stacks in realistic environments. We present and release a vulnerability assessment solution that efficiently addresses these limitations. Our approach combines systematic vulnerability discovery, leveraging public Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE) databases, within a dockerized development environment that evaluates exploitability risks. The results reveal both breadth of potential threats and the practical constraints we faced during exploitation. We discuss the implications for industry and research, and propose directions for building more resilient SDVs.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对下一代汽车操作系统（即软件定义汽车SDV中的操作系统）的漏洞监控问题展开研究。随着汽车向软件定义方向演进，车辆集成了复杂的硬件和软件系统，带来了显著的安全挑战。作者指出，现有的漏洞评估工具在处理操作系统漏洞方面存在不足，尤其难以在真实环境中高效分析多样化的软件栈。为此，论文提出并发布了一套漏洞评估解决方案，该方案结合了系统化的漏洞发现方法，利用公共CVE数据库，并在Docker化开发环境中评估漏洞的可利用性风险。实验结果表明了潜在威胁的广泛性以及实际利用过程中面临的实际约束。论文讨论了研究结果对工业界和学术界的启示，并提出了构建更具弹性的SDV的改进方向。本文适合汽车安全研究人员、车载系统开发者以及关注操作系统安全的从业者阅读。

items.title: Finding and Understanding Miscompilation Bugs in the Solidity Compiler
items.summary: Smart contract compilers are critical to ensuring the correctness of public blockchains whose defining characteristics are open-source and immutable code. We created SolSmith, a semantics-aware differential fuzz testing tool, to improve the quality of the Solidity compiler -- the most popular compiler for the Ethereum blockchain -- and spent over three years finding compiler defects that produce incorrect code. We call these defects miscompilation bugs. During this time period, we have discovered 25 miscompilation bugs that went unnoticed, some for multiple years. Our first contribution is to make compiler testing more rigorous. SolSmith achieves this goal by generating valid test programs that are likely to stress test code generation and optimization components. This helps SolSmith find bugs missed during routine testing that could potentially have serious implications for smart contracts and their users. Our second contribution is a qualitative and quantitative analysis of miscompilation bugs that we found in the Solidity compiler. We classify miscompilation bugs found by SolSmith based on their nature, root-causes, and impact on end-users. This sheds light on some pitfalls of optimizing compilers.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文针对以太坊智能合约编译器Solidity的质量问题，提出了一种语义感知的差异模糊测试工具SolSmith。智能合约编译器的正确性对于确保区块链上不可变代码的可靠性至关重要。作者在三年的时间里，利用SolSmith发现了25个此前未被注意的误编译缺陷（miscompilation bugs），其中一些缺陷存在多年。SolSmith通过生成有效的测试程序，刻意压测编译器的代码生成和优化组件，从而发现常规测试遗漏的bug。论文对这些误编译bug进行了定性和定量分析，根据性质、根本原因和对最终用户的影响进行分类，揭示了优化编译器的一些陷阱。研究背景：区块链智能合约的不可篡改性要求编译器输出绝对正确，任何bug都可能导致严重的经济损失。贡献：1）提出更严格的编译器测试方法；2）对Solidity编译器中发现的误编译bug进行深入分析。适合读的人群：区块链安全研究人员、编译器开发工程师、智能合约开发者。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 智能合约编译器bug可能导致链上代码执行错误，造成不可逆的经济损失。SolSmith工具的实践表明，常规测试难以发现深层误编译bug，本工作为编译器质量保障提供了新思路。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接提升Solidity编译器可靠性，间接影响所有基于以太坊的智能合约安全性。方法可迁移至其他区块链编译器（如Vyper、Move等）的测试。

items.title: Evaluating Endpoint Detection Robustness Against Genetic Algorithm Driven Code Transformations
items.summary: Post-compromise test variants are widely used in controlled security evaluation and endpoint robustness benchmarking. However, modern Antivirus (AV) and Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) systems increasingly combine signature- and behavior-based detection, challenging the reliability of conventional detection pipelines under adaptive variation. This study introduces ShellForge, a Genetic Algorithm (GA)-driven framework that evolves post-compromise variants representative of remote command execution to generate functionally equivalent variants for systematic detection evaluation. ShellForge applies syntactic transformations, encoding schemes, and structural permutations guided by a multi-objective fitness function informed by AV and EDR detection feedback. We compare ShellForge against representative baseline transformation frameworks under identical sandbox configurations. Our findings highlight measurable robustness gaps in baseline signature- and behavior-oriented detection pipelines under controlled variant generation. In addition, we propose a reproducible benchmark for endpoint detection robustness evaluation, motivating the need for robustness-aware defensive monitoring and behavioral correlation.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文针对现代端点检测系统在自适应攻击变体下的鲁棒性评估问题，提出了一种基于遗传算法（GA）的自动化框架ShellForge。研究背景是：传统的签名和基于行为的检测方法在应对经过混淆或变形的攻击载荷时可能出现失效，而现有基准测试方法难以系统性地评估检测系统对变体生成策略的鲁棒性。ShellForge以远程命令执行后的测试变体为对象，通过遗传算法驱动对载荷进行句法变换、编码混淆和结构排列，生成功能等价的变体，并利用多目标适应度函数（结合AV/EDR检测反馈）指导进化过程。实验在沙盒环境下将ShellForge与传统基线变换框架进行对比，结果表明基线检测系统在签名和行为检测管道上存在显著的鲁棒性差距。论文的主要贡献包括：（1）提出了一种可复现的端点检测鲁棒性评估基准；（2）揭示了当前检测系统在面对遗传算法生成的变体时的脆弱性；（3）为防御性监控和行为关联分析提供了改进方向。该研究适合安全研究员、EDR开发人员和检测工程团队阅读，有助于理解基于AI的自动变形对检测的挑战。

items.title: Certifying Ghosts: How Cybersecurity AI Agents Break the EU Cyber Resilience Act
items.summary: The EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) makes a smart bet. It does not demand that products be free of vulnerabilities, but only that manufacturers run a process: assess risk, handle flaws, ship updates. The bet pays off if four things about the world stay true: (P1) finding vulnerabilities is slow, skilled, human work; (P2) a product's exploitable flaws are knowable the day it ships; (P3) exploitation is rare enough to notice; and (P4) fixes keep pace with discovery. Cybersecurity AI (CAI) agents, AI put to work finding and exploiting flaws in other products, falsify all four. The regime answers in two opposite ways. Against the sheer volume of flaws that agents surface it bends (P1): built for scarce attention, it re-centres compliance on defensible, documented prioritisation, and holds. But agents also collapse the speed and economics of the vulnerability lifecycle, and here it breaks (P2, P3, P4): a product that passed every check becomes exploitable without anyone touching it, so its market-entry test, its reporting trigger, and its one-and-done certificate vouch for a security that has quietly expired. The fault is in the landscape, not the product, so running the process more diligently cannot repair it. We map each mechanism to the force that strains or snaps it, and find the cure and the disease cut from the same cloth: because defenders and attackers wield the same AI, the only conformity that survives is one that never stops running. We also carry the remedy from proposal to proof on two CRA-scope robots, a humanoid and a lawn mower, where an agentic defender holds a line their undefended selves cannot. On the evidence already in hand, the CRA reaches full force in December 2027 certifying products against a world that has already changed. Static, human-paced security is finished; what replaces it must be continuous and agent-operated, and that is no longer a matter of taste.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文分析了欧盟《网络弹性法案》（CRA）在网络安全AI代理（CAI agents）普及背景下的失效风险。CRA的核心逻辑是要求制造商执行风险流程（评估、修复、更新），而非保证产品绝对无漏洞，其有效性依赖于四个隐含前提：（P1）漏洞发现是缓慢、需要熟练人工的工作；（P2）产品出厂时的可被利用漏洞是可知的；（P3）被利用事件足够罕见以至于能及时察觉；（P4）修复速度跟得上新发现的速度。然而，能够自动寻找和利用漏洞的CAI代理同时打破了所有四个前提：一方面，它大幅增加漏洞暴露量，使CRA基于有限注意力的优先排序机制变得可行但压力骤增；另一方面，它彻底压缩了漏洞生命周期的速度和成本，导致产品在通过所有检验后仍可被远程赋予新漏洞（P2、P3、P4失效），使得市场准入测试、报告触发条件和一次性认证证书所担保的安全性悄然过期。作者指出，问题根源在于整体生态而非单个产品，因此更严格的流程执行也无济于事。作为解决方案，论文提出“永不停止的持续安全”框架，即防御方与攻击方使用相同的AI代理，在CRA范围内的两型机器人（人形机器人和割草机器人）上进行了原理论证。结论是：到2027年CRA全面实施时，静态、人工节奏的安全已过时，安全必须转向持续、代理驱动的模式。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示了当前主流网络安全合规框架（CRA）在面对AI自动化攻击时的根本性缺陷，提示安全从业者必须重新设计持续性的安全验证体系。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 对依赖一次性认证的合规流程（如CRA）产生范式冲击，可能影响未来监管框架的修订，并推动“持续安全认证”概念落地。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 建议安全团队关注AI代理对传统安全流程的颠覆性影响，评估自身产品的漏洞生命周期是否已无法被人工节奏覆盖，并研究持续自动化防御方案。

items.title: Is Randomness Necessary for Adaptive Data Analysis?
items.summary: The Adaptive Data Analysis (ADA) problem formalizes the challenge of preventing false discovery and overfitting when a dataset is repeatedly reused. Formally, our input is a dataset containing $n$ i.i.d. samples from an unknown distribution $\mathcal{P}$ over a domain $\mathcal{X}$, and our goal is to answer a sequence of $k$ adaptively chosen statistical queries with respect to $\mathcal{P}$. The main question is how many queries we can support (i.e., how large $k$ can be), primarily as a function of the number of samples $n$. This question has been intensively studied and is relatively well-understood for randomized mechanisms: there are computationally efficient mechanisms that support $k \approx n^2$ queries, and no computationally efficient mechanism can answer $k \gg n^2$ queries. In this paper, we address a fundamental question: is randomness necessary for ADA? Despite a decade of work on ADA, this question remains open. A folklore observation dating back to the initial works on ADA is that randomness is not necessary when the analyst is computationally bounded. Yet, the necessity of randomness against computationally unbounded analysts has remained elusive. Our main contribution resolves this gap in the information-theoretic Random Oracle model. Perhaps surprisingly, we show that randomness is strictly necessary to answer a non-trivial number of adaptive queries: when the analyst is unbounded, any deterministic mechanism can be forced to fail after just $k = \tilde{O} (n)$ queries.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究自适应数据分析（ADA）问题，该问题形式化了数据集重复使用时防止虚假发现和过拟合的挑战。输入包含从未知分布 P 中独立同分布采样的 n 个样本，目标是回答 k 个自适应选择的统计查询。主要问题在于支持多少查询（即 k 的最大值）主要取决于样本数 n。已有研究表明，对于随机化机制，存在计算高效的机制可支持约 n^2 次查询，且任何计算高效机制无法支持远大于 n^2 的查询。本文解决了一个基本问题：随机性对于 ADA 是否是必要的？尽管过去十年有大量研究，该问题仍未解决。早期研究的一个民间观察认为，当分析者计算能力受限时随机性并非必要，但对于计算无界分析者随机性的必要性仍不清楚。本文的主要贡献在信息论随机预言机模型中弥合了这一差距。令人惊讶的是，我们证明随机性对于回答非平凡数量的自适应查询是严格必要的：当分析者无界时，任何确定性机制在仅 k = O~(n) 次查询后就会被强制失败。这表明随机化机制在理论上优于确定性机制，并加深了对自适应数据分析中随机性作用的理解。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该论文揭示了在自适应数据分析中随机性的必要性，这对于数据重用场景下的统计有效性具有根本性意义，可直接影响安全分析中的统计推断和机器学习模型的过拟合防护。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 理论结果，主要影响机器学习理论、差分隐私、自适应数据分析领域，对安全领域中的隐私保护和模型泛化分析有启示作用。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: Deanonymizing Monero Transactions in Tor Network
items.summary: Monero is a privacy-focused cryptocurrency that deploys the Dandelion++ protocol and incorporates anonymity networks (such as Tor and I2P) to prevent malicious attackers from linking transactions with their source IPs. In this paper, we demonstrate that Monero's integration of the Tor network introduces a fundamental vulnerability: a Monero Tor node's originated transactions are exclusively forwarded to two outgoing Tor hidden service nodes (proxy nodes) prior to clearnet propagation, enabling an adversary to capture originated transactions by occupying the target node's outgoing connections. Based on this observation, we propose \textit{ProxyMark}, a three-stage deanonymization framework for the Monero Tor network, comprising node role identification, originated transaction identification, and node location deanonymization. Through experiments on the live Tor network, Monero mainnet, and testnet, we empirically demonstrate the effectiveness of \textit{ProxyMark} in successfully deanonymizing transactions originating from Monero nodes over Tor.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究了门罗币（Monero）在集成Tor网络时引入的隐私漏洞。门罗币是一种注重隐私的加密货币，采用Dandelion++协议和匿名网络（如Tor和I2P）来防止攻击者将交易与源IP关联。论文发现，门罗币的Tor节点发出的交易在传播到公网之前，会专门转发给两个出站Tor隐藏服务节点（代理节点）。这一机制导致攻击者可以通过占据目标节点的出站连接来捕获其发出的交易。基于此，作者提出了ProxyMark，一个三阶段去匿名化框架：节点角色识别、发起交易识别和节点位置去匿名化。通过在真实Tor网络、门罗币主网和测试网上的实验，证明了ProxyMark能够成功对通过Tor发起的门罗币交易进行去匿名化。该研究揭示了隐私加密货币与匿名网络结合时可能产生的新的攻击面，对门罗币用户的隐私构成威胁。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示了门罗币与Tor集成中的设计缺陷，使得攻击者可以绕过匿名保护，对隐私币用户造成实际威胁。安全从业者需关注此类跨系统交互引发的漏洞。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响使用Tor网络的门罗币用户，可能导致交易源IP和地理位置泄露，破坏门罗币的匿名性。类似漏洞可能存在于其他集成匿名网络的加密货币中。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: An Automated Framework for Generating Stealthy Cell-Embedded Hardware Trojans
items.summary: Hardware Trojans (HTs) pose significant threats across the Integrated Circuit (IC) design lifecycle because they can be inserted by untrusted entities at different stages under the zero-trust model. When triggered under rare conditions, HTs can compromise the functionality, reliability, or security of the fabricated chip. HT assessment is typically performed by modeling realistic Trojan insertion scenarios in RTL implementation or gate-level netlists. While this model is useful for evaluating detection methods, it does not capture attacks where malicious behavior is hidden inside standard-cell implementations from a compromised library supplied by an untrusted vendor. This paper presents a novel framework for automatically generating cell-embedded hardware Trojans using compromised standard-cell implementations. Our proposed framework analyzes a mapped design, identifies candidate cell instances with rare input conditions, and applies payload templates that corrupt the selected cell output only when the trigger condition is satisfied. Experiments on open-source combinational and sequential benchmark designs show that our proposed framework can generate valid and stealthy Trojan instances across different cell types and design sizes. The results highlight a critical gap in current Trojan detection assumptions and show the need for cell-aware validation of standard-cell implementations in zero-trust IC design flows.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出了一种自动生成嵌入式硬件特洛伊木马（HT）的框架，利用受损的标准单元库在集成电路（IC）设计流程中植入隐蔽后门。传统的HT评估通常基于RTL或门级网表建模，但忽略了攻击者可能通过恶意标准单元库植入HT的场景。作者设计的框架包含两个关键阶段：首先，分析综合后的网表，识别具有罕见输入状态的候选标准单元实例（这些状态难以被常规测试激活）；然后，应用预定义的负载模板，仅在满足触发条件时篡改所选单元的输出。实验基于开源组合和时序基准电路，该框架成功生成了多种类型、大小不同的有效且隐蔽的HT实例，且能绕过现有的HT检测方法。论文指出现有检测假设的漏洞，强调了在零信任IC设计流程中对标准单元实现进行单元级验证的必要性。对于硬件安全研究人员和EDA工具开发者，该工作揭示了新型攻击面，并为开发相应的检测与防御机制提供了基础。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示了当前HT检测方法未覆盖的攻击面，即标准单元库级别的HT植入，可能被恶意代工厂利用，对芯片安全构成严重威胁。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 影响芯片制造供应链安全，尤其是使用第三方标准单元库的零信任设计流程；攻击可导致功能失效、信息泄露或后门植入。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 纳入内部评估

items.title: SA-DRL: Security-Aware Deep Reinforcement Learning for Ransomware Detection with Asymmetric Reward Design
items.summary: Ransomware detection is a security-critical task in which false negatives and false positives have unequal operational consequences. Conventional machine learning detectors often use symmetric objectives that penalize missed ransomware detections and benign false alarms equally, although a false negative can cause irreversible encryption, operational disruption, and high recovery cost, whereas a false positive is usually reversible. This study proposes a Security-Aware Deep Reinforcement Learning (SA-DRL) framework that embeds false-negative and false-positive cost asymmetry into the reinforcement learning reward signal to prioritize missed-detection reduction. The framework also introduces a Security-Optimal Model Selection (SOMS) criterion and an adaptive episode-level sample-ordering mechanism. Four deep reinforcement learning agents, DQN, DDQN, PPO, and A2C, were evaluated using a symmetric baseline reward (R1) and a security-aware asymmetric reward (R2). Experiments used four discount factors, five-fold cross-validation, and three random seeds, resulting in 480 training runs on a balanced ransomware detection dataset. The SOMS criterion selects models by prioritizing false-negative rate, followed by F1-score and training time. Results show that asymmetric reward shaping improves security-oriented detection performance. The SOMS-selected configuration, DDQN with R2 and gamma = 0.1, achieved a false-negative rate of 0.0080, an F1-score of 0.9915, and an AUC of 0.998, reducing missed detections by 67.6% compared with the best supervised baseline. Across all configurations, R2 reduced the mean false-negative rate by 43% relative to R1. These findings show that reward-function design is important for security-sensitive ransomware detection.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文提出了一种名为SA-DRL（Security-Aware Deep Reinforcement Learning）的安全感知深度强化学习框架，用于勒索软件检测。传统的机器学习检测器通常使用对称目标函数，即对漏报和误报施加相同惩罚，但在勒索软件场景中，漏报可能导致不可逆的加密、业务中断和高昂的恢复成本，而误报通常是可逆的。因此，框架将漏报和误报的成本不对称性嵌入强化学习的奖励信号中，以优先减少漏报。此外，框架引入了安全最优模型选择（SOMS）准则和自适应逐 episode 样本排序机制。实验评估了四种深度强化学习代理：DQN、DDQN、PPO和A2C，使用对称基线奖励（R1）和安全感知非对称奖励（R2）进行对比。实验基于平衡的勒索软件检测数据集，采用四个折扣因子、五折交叉验证和三个随机种子，共进行480次训练运行。SOMS准则优先考虑漏报率，然后是F1分数和训练时间。结果表明，非对称奖励塑造提高了面向安全的检测性能。由SOMS选择的配置为DDQN + R2 + gamma=0.1，实现了漏报率0.0080、F1分数0.9915、AUC 0.998，与最佳监督基线相比，漏报减少67.6%。在所有配置中，R2相对于R1使平均漏报率降低43%。这些发现表明奖励函数设计对于安全敏感的勒索软件检测至关重要。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究针对勒索软件检测中漏报代价远高于误报的实际问题，提出了一种通过非对称奖励设计优化深度强化学习检测器的方法，显著降低了漏报率，对于提升安全运营效率具有直接参考价值。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 该方法可迁移至其他安全检测任务（如入侵检测、恶意软件分类），特别是在误报和漏报成本严重不平衡的场景中。
llm_summary.recommended_action_zh: 研究跟进

items.title: Auditable Machine Unlearning for Privacy-Compliant Ransomware Detection Using Multi-Shard SISA and Deep Reinforcement Learning
items.summary: Ransomware poses an escalating cybersecurity threat as attackers continuously modify behavioral patterns to evade static defenses. Although existing machine learning-based detectors often achieve strong predictive performance, they generally assume fixed training data and do not support the selective removal of previously learned samples. This limitation conflicts with privacy regulations such as the GDPR and CCPA, which require the removal of sensitive user data upon request. To address this challenge, we propose an auditable ransomware detection and unlearning framework that integrates deep reinforcement learning with multi-shard SISA retraining. In the proposed system, a Double Deep Q-Network (DDQN) learns a reward-guided detection policy from behavioral features under asymmetric security costs, while multi-shard SISA enables privacy-compliant selective sample removal through shard-level retraining. The framework was evaluated using four criteria: utility preservation, oracle-based forgetting validation, membership inference auditing, and computational efficiency. On a balanced Windows 11 behavioral dataset comprising 2,000 samples and 103 features, the baseline DDQN detector achieved an F1 score of 0.9925 and an AUC of 0.9983. The experimental results show that single-shard unlearning maintains minimal utility degradation and low oracle disagreement, whereas moderate shard counts (M = 5-10) provide the best efficiency-performance trade-off, reducing retraining time to 5-30 s compared with 80-330 s for full retraining. In addition, the membership inference scores remain close to 0.5 across most configurations, indicating limited privacy leakage after unlearning. These findings demonstrate that a privacy-compliant ransomware detection framework can jointly achieve high detection performance, auditable deletion verification, and efficient sample removal.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文提出了一种可审计的机器学习卸载框架，旨在解决隐私合规的勒索软件检测问题。随着勒索软件不断变异行为模式以逃避静态防御，现有基于机器学习的检测器通常假设训练数据固定，不支持选择性移除已学习样本，这与GDPR和CCPA等隐私法规要求按需删除用户敏感数据相冲突。为此，作者将深度强化学习与多分片SISA（分片隔离收缩与重新训练）技术相结合。具体地，使用双深度Q网络（DDQN）从行为特征中学习奖励引导的检测策略，并引入非对称安全成本；多分片SISA通过分片级别的重新训练实现隐私合规的选择性样本移除，同时支持可审计的删除验证。框架评估涵盖四个维度：效用保持、基于oracle的遗忘验证、成员推断审计和计算效率。在包含2000个样本和103个特征的平衡Windows 11行为数据集上，基线DDQN检测器取得0.9925的F1分数和0.9983的AUC。实验表明，单分片卸载保持极小的效用降级和低的oracle分歧；中等分片数量（M=5-10）提供了最佳的效率-性能权衡，将重新训练时间从完全重新训练的80-330秒降低至5-30秒。此外，大多数配置下成员推断分数接近0.5，表明卸载后隐私泄露有限。这些发现证明隐私合规的勒索软件检测框架能同时实现高检测性能、可审计的删除验证和高效的样本移除。该研究适用于关注隐私保护机器学习、安全检测系统合规性以及可审计模型更新的研究人员和从业者。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 该研究首次将可审计的机器学习卸载引入勒索软件检测领域，为符合GDPR等隐私法规的防御系统提供了可行方案，适合需要处理用户数据删除请求的安全团队关注。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 可应用于任何需要数据删除权限的安全检测系统（如端点威胁检测、邮件过滤），特别是涉及用户隐私数据处理的场景。

items.title: Behavioral Privacy Leakage in Agentic Negotiation: Formalizing and Mitigating Inference Attacks via Randomized Policies
items.summary: Autonomous negotiation agents are increasingly deployed in high-stakes settings such as insurance and procurement. While cryptographic techniques protect explicitly disclosed constraint values, they fail to address a subtler threat: behavioral privacy leakage, where an adversary infers private constraints from observable negotiation dynamics such as concession trajectories, timing, and convergence patterns. This paper investigates behavioral differential privacy in multi-round negotiation protocols. We design an adaptive stochastic negotiation policy that jointly guarantees $(\varepsilon, δ)$-differential privacy, almost-sure convergence of the offer sequence (reaching agreement when the counterparty's reservation value permits), and high negotiation utility. Evaluated on 3,000 synthetic bilateral negotiations, our mechanism reduces adversarial inference accuracy by 43-50% while maintaining a negotiation success rate and utility above 90%, demonstrating that strong privacy guarantees can be achieved without significant loss of performance.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 本文研究了自主谈判智能体在保险、采购等高危场景中的行为隐私泄露问题。尽管现有密码技术能够保护显式披露的约束值，但无法防止对手通过观察谈判动态（如让步轨迹、时序和收敛模式）推断智能体的私有约束。作者形式化了行为差分隐私问题，并设计了一种自适应随机谈判策略，该策略同时满足(ε, δ)-差分隐私、offer序列几乎必然收敛（当对手的保留价值允许时达成协议）以及高谈判效用。在3000个合成的双边谈判数据集上评估，该方法将对手推理准确率降低43-50%，同时将谈判成功率和效用保持在90%以上，证明了强隐私保障可以在不显著牺牲性能的情况下实现。本文为谈判智能体的隐私保护提供了理论基础和实用方案。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 揭示了谈判智能体中行为模式泄露隐私的风险，并提供了可证明的差分隐私保护框架，对部署自动化谈判系统的企业具有重要安全启示。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 适用于保险、采购、电子商务等依赖自动化谈判的高风险场景，可防范对手通过观察谈判行为推断商业机密或用户隐私。

items.title: Assessing the Operational Impact of Poisoning Attacks over Augmented 3D Point Cloud Public Datasets for Connected and Autonomous Vehicles
items.summary: Poisoning attacks against public datasets lead to major concerns, such as (i) misclassification of perceived objects when the poisoned data is used for training and (ii) embedding of backdoors that may eventually be triggered later on, when specific conditions in the system apply over the learned models. Its impact over data augmentation models is unclear. While data augmentation reduces the likelihood of poisoning attack success, some valid questions remain. Is data augmentation affecting the impact of poisoning attacks? can it increase the number of poisoned samples or injected backdoors? We explore in this paper some of these questions. We assess the effects of augmenting poisoned 3D point cloud datasets and validate that poisoning is able to evade the sanitizing nature of augmentation techniques when using the concrete case of Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) techniques to exemplify the case of data augmentation processing. We also validate that poisoning propagates over the augmented datasets and perturbs the decision made by general-purpose classifiers, in the end. All the experimental material (including tools, datasets, and classifiers) is publicly available, to facilitate reproducibility and to foster further research in the topic.

llm_summary.summary_zh: 该论文研究了针对增强后的3D点云公共数据集的投毒攻击对自动驾驶系统的影响。投毒攻击会导致训练模型对感知对象分类错误，或嵌入后门触发条件。尽管数据增强通常被认为可以降低投毒成功率，但论文通过实验验证，在使用生成对抗网络（GAN）进行数据增强的情况下，投毒攻击仍然能够逃避增强的净化作用，并传播到增强后的数据集中，最终影响通用分类器的决策。论文公开了所有实验材料（包括工具、数据集和分类器），以促进可重复性和后续研究。
llm_summary.why_it_matters_zh: 3D点云数据是自动驾驶感知的关键，投毒攻击可导致车辆误判或产生后门，威胁行车安全。本研究揭示数据增强并非安全的万灵药，对安全社区重新评估数据管道风险具有警示意义。
llm_summary.impact_zh: 直接影响自动驾驶系统基于公共数据集训练时的模型安全性；可迁移至其他依赖3D点云数据的场景（如机器人、安防）。
